name: @toros/mcp-discovery
description: Local stdio MCP server that exposes operator-granted read-only discovery (spec AT) to a Claude or Codex session
_comment_entrypoints: tsconfig sets rootDir '.' so that src/ and test/ both compile, which puts the emitted entrypoint at dist/src/index.js — not dist/index.js. These paths must match that layout or every consumer fails with TS2307 'Cannot find module @toros/mcp-discovery'.
